verdict.rationale: The evidence shows AnythingLLM runs locally and keeps document knowledge bases on-device, but nothing documents an assistant memory store that users can inspect, edit, or delete, or that it uses an open format. Local document RAG and the workspace developer API are adjacent features or building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can inspect, edit, and delete what the assistant has remembered — the memory store lives on my machine in an open format
